notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strong activations are a mix of docstring section markers (Returns, :return:, :type) and medical/structured-article headings (INTERVENTIONS, Symptoms, Tests), all at the token that names a field just before its content; the strongest are numpy-style 'Returns' headings. Only about 0.15% of tokens are over a tenth of max, and no single token explains most of the pole.
